title: Application to Student Visa Process Steps for Germany

processSteps.label: University Application : via uni-assist.de or direct university portal
bullets: uni-assist fee: ~75 EUR (first) + 30 EUR each additional
Prepare: CV, Motivation Letter, 2 References, IELTS/TOEFL, transcripts

processSteps.label: Admission Letter & Blocked Account (Sperrkonto)
bullets: Open Sperrkonto with Coracle, Expatrio, or Deutsche Bank — deposit 11,904 EUR/year
Receive Blocked Account Confirmation Letter for visa application

processSteps.label: Health Insurance Arrangement
bullets: Public insurance (TK, AOK, Barmer): ~110–130 EUR/month — required for visa
Student rate valid up to age 30 or 14th semester

processSteps.label: Student Visa Application : via German Embassy Dhaka
bullets: Register at German Embassy Dhaka Consular Services Portal first
Master's: via VFS Global Dhaka | Bachelor's: submit directly at Embassy

processSteps.label: Arrive in Germany & Register (Anmeldung)
bullets: Register at Einwohnermeldeamt within 2 weeks — receive Steuer-ID

processSteps.label: Residence Permit (Aufenthaltserlaubnis)
bullets: Apply at local Ausländerbehörde — fee: ~100 EUR
Bring: enrollment certificate, blocked account proof, insurance

costSteps.label: Blocked Account (Sperrkonto) : 11,904 EUR — withdrawn monthly (992 EUR/month) after arrival
Student Visa Fee : EUR-based fixed amount, paid in BDT at time of submission
VFS Global Service Fee : ~30–35 EUR — visa submission (Master's only)
Semester Contribution : 150–350 EUR/semester — includes transport pass in many states
Air Ticket to Germany : varies by season
